summary: Global Tech Industries Group, Inc., via a court-appointed receiver, filed an 8-K attaching the Receiver's Seventh Interim Report covering activities from the prior report through April 21, 2026, in the ongoing Nevada state-court receivership (White Rocks (BVI) Holdings Inc. v. David Reichman et al.). The report details the auditor's resignation, delayed audits for FY2023/2024, tracing of misappropriated funds, property/storage issues, and pending litigation. The receiver continues to manage the company under court supervision with no specified terms, price, or premium. Investors should monitor future filings for recovery progress or potential sale/liquidation recommendations.
